- [AI-Powered Assistant | Screencastify](https://www.screencastify.com/features/ai-assistant): Enhance your videos with AI-powered features like titles, descriptions, and captions. From editing to engagement, create polished, impactful content faster than ever.

- [Premium Video Library | Screencastify](https://www.screencastify.com/features/premium-library): Access Screencastify’s Premium Library with ready-to-use video lessons, templates, and resources to save teachers time and engage students.
- [World Languages & Translations | Screencastify](https://www.screencastify.com/features/world-languages): Support world language learning with Screencastify. Create immersive video lessons, boost speaking practice, and engage multilingual learners.

## Legal

- [Privacy Policy | Screencastify](https://www.screencastify.com/legal/privacy): Learn how Screencastify collects, uses, and protects your information. Review our Privacy Policy for details on data security and user rights.

- [Terms of Service | Screencastify](https://www.screencastify.com/legal/terms): Review Screencastify’s Terms of Service to understand your rights, responsibilities, and guidelines for using our products and services.

## Partnerships

- [Canvas Integration | Screencastify](https://www.screencastify.com/partnerships/canvas): Access Screencastify videos in Canvas seamlessly. Add videos to assignments without leaving your LMS. Students watch in Canvas too.
- [Screencastify Partners with Google | Screencastify](https://www.screencastify.com/partnerships/google): Screencastify is a trusted Google for Education partner, helping schools and teachers seamlessly integrate video into their Google-powered classrooms.
- [Screencastify Partners with Modern Classroom Project | Screencastify](https://www.screencastify.com/partnerships/modern-classrooms-project): Explore Screencastify’s partnership with the Modern Classrooms Project to support self-paced, student-centered learning through video.
- [Screencastify Partners with NAACE | Screencastify](https://www.screencastify.com/partnerships/naace): Discover how Screencastify and NAACE are partnering to support digital education strategies and elevate teaching and learning across the UK.

## Products

- [Free Screen Recording Chrome Extension | Screencastify](https://www.screencastify.com/products/screen-recorder): Add the Screencastify record extension to Chrome to start recording in seconds. No download required.
- [Student Video Submissions Made Easy | Screencastify](https://www.screencastify.com/products/submit): Use Screencastify for a fast, secure, and easy way for your students to record and submit video assignments from nearly any device.
- [Free Online Video Creation Tools | Screencastify](https://www.screencastify.com/products/video-editor): Quickly and easily edit any video. Annotate, add title cards, and trim with a click of a button! Create polished videos in seconds.

- [Collect Video Responses in Google Classroom | Screencastify](https://www.screencastify.com/videos/collect-video-responses-in-google-classroom): With Screencastify Submit, creating a video assignment on Google Classroom takes just a few simple steps.
- [Combat Learning Loss with the Power of Video | Screencastify](https://www.screencastify.com/videos/combat-learning-loss-with-screencastify): Extended breaks for students such as summer or holidays can lead to learning loss. Fortunately, there are ways to combat the slide through video.
- [Consolidate Tech Tools to Fight Fatigue | Screencastify](https://www.screencastify.com/videos/consolidate-tech-to-fight-fatigue): We discuss the challenges and tech fatigue that teachers can face with overly complicated tech stacks and workflows.
- [Create Study Habits with Screencastify | Screencastify](https://www.screencastify.com/videos/create-better-studying-habits-for-students-with-video): In this episode of EdTech Heroes, host Nef Dukes welcomes Mandy Adams of Franklin Public Schools.
- [Self-Paced Learning with Kareem Farah | Screencastify](https://www.screencastify.com/videos/discussing-importance-of-self-paced-learning-with-kareem-farah): Nef Dukes and Kareem Farah discuss empowering students through connection, engagement, and innovative educational content.
- [EdTech Skills with Kasey Bell | Screencastify](https://www.screencastify.com/videos/discussing-most-important-edtech-skill-with-kasey-bell): Nefertiti Dukes interviews Kasey Bell, CEO of Shake Up Learning, about adapting education strategies for the new normal.
- [All the Magic of Screencastify Edit | Screencastify](https://www.screencastify.com/videos/export-screencastify-edit-to-video-management-page): Export videos to Screencastify from Edit to unlock interactive questions, viewer analytics, and powerful video management tools.
- [Assign Videos to Spark Discussion | Screencastify | Screencastify](https://www.screencastify.com/videos/facilitate-classroom-discussion-with-screencastify-submit): Give students a place to share their work and ideas with each other. - [Flip Your Back to School Night | Screencastify](https://www.screencastify.com/videos/flip-back-to-school-night-with-screencastify): Missed Open House? Record classroom updates with Screencastify so every parent stays informed about their child's education.
- [Learn About Your Colleagues Through Video | Screencastify](https://www.screencastify.com/videos/get-to-know-colleagues-with-screencastify-submit): Get to know your colleagues better this year. Use Screencastify Submit for staff to create introduction videos and build connections.

- [How Games Teach SEL Skills | Screencastify](https://www.screencastify.com/videos/how-games-make-powerful-social-emotional-learning): Nefertiti Dukes talks with Susan Rivers, Executive Director and Chief Scientist at iThrive Games.

- [Integrate the 4 Cs with Screencastify | Screencastify](https://www.screencastify.com/videos/how-teachers-can-integrate-the-four-cs-into-lessons): Adam Juarez discusses ISTE events, his own participation, and he describe some of his informative sessions.

- [Foster PLC Discussions with Video | Screencastify](https://www.screencastify.com/videos/two-minute-drill-episode-3-foster-discussion-with-your-plc): Building up an awesome community of educators? Try using Screencastify Submit to stay in touch and share best practices.
- [Unlock Learning with Video Editing | Screencastify](https://www.screencastify.com/videos/unlock-personalized-learning-and-engagement-with-video-editing): Learn how video editing can be the key to unlocking personalized learning and student engagement in any classroom environment with Screencastify.
- [Use Video to Check Reading Fluency | Screencastify](https://www.screencastify.com/videos/use-video-to-check-reading-fluency): Looking for a way to hear students read more often or to assess reading fluency? With Submit, you can!
- [Using Tech to Give Students a Choice | Screencastify](https://www.screencastify.com/videos/using-tech-to-give-students-a-choice-with-kyle-niemis): EdTech Hero Kyle Niemis talks about his products - Classroom Q and My EdTech Bundle, organized chaos, and his advice for returning to the classroom.
- [Announcing Closed Captions in Beta | Screencastify](https://www.screencastify.com/videos/video-announcing-closed-captions-in-beta): Screencastify's new closed captions beta feature helps make any video more accessible to every educator and every student.

- [Celebrate the Year with One Tool | Screencastify](https://www.screencastify.com/videos/webinar-replay-celebrate-with-screencastify): Check out the different ways to use Screencastify to honor teachers, celebrate students, and immortalize the school year.
- [What's New in Screencastify? | Screencastify](https://www.screencastify.com/videos/whats-new-in-screencastify): What's new at Screencastify? We're always improving, and we have sweet new updates across our entire video creation suite.
